name: S&P 500 Opening Range Breakout - Two-Way Breakout Analysis
description: Research study analyzing the S&P 500 Index (SPX) opening range breakout patterns. The opening range is defined as 09:30 to 09:45 ET (15-minute window). This study calculates how often price breaks out in BOTH directions on the same day after the opening range is set - a key measure of false breakouts and intraday volatility patterns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# S&P 500 OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT - TWO-WAY BREAKOUT ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Opening Range: 09:30-09:45 ET (15 minutes)
# Research Question: What % of breakout days see BOTH upside AND downside breakouts?
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
spx = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.SPX, timeframe=5Min)()
close = spx.c
high = spx.h
low = spx.l
open_price = spx.o

# === OPENING RANGE SESSION (09:30-09:45 ET) ===
opening_range = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='09:45', tz='America/New_York'))()
or_high = opening_range.high
or_low = opening_range.low
or_open = opening_range.open
or_closed = opening_range.closed

# Opening range width (as percentage of opening price)
or_width_raw = (or_high - or_low) / or_open
or_width_pct = where(or_closed, or_width_raw)

# Forward-fill opening range levels throughout the trading day
or_high_filled = ffill_day()(or_high)
or_low_filled = ffill_day()(or_low)

# === POST-OPENING RANGE SESSION (09:45-16:00 ET) ===
post_or = session_window(session=Session(start='09:45', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))()
post_or_active = post_or.active

# === BREAKOUT DETECTION (bar-level) ===
# Upside breakout: close above opening range high (during post-OR period)
upside_break_bar = post_or_active and (close > or_high_filled)

# Downside breakout: close below opening range low (during post-OR period)
downside_break_bar = post_or_active and (close < or_low_filled)

# === DAILY AGGREGATION ===
# Aggregate to daily level: did upside/downside breakout occur today?
upside_break_day = session_agg(session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'), agg=AggregationType.Any)(upside_break_bar)
downside_break_day = session_agg(session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'), agg=AggregationType.Any)(downside_break_bar)

# === DAILY PATTERNS ===
# Two-way breakout: BOTH directions on same day
two_way_break = upside_break_day and downside_break_day

# Any breakout: at least one direction
any_break = upside_break_day or downside_break_day

# Single-direction breakouts
upside_only = upside_break_day and (downside_break_day == False)
downside_only = downside_break_day and (upside_break_day == False)

# No breakout
no_break = (any_break == False)

# === COUNT INDICATORS (for aggregation) ===
count_any = where(any_break, 1, 0)
count_two_way = where(two_way_break, 1, 0)
count_upside_only = where(upside_only, 1, 0)
count_downside_only = where(downside_only, 1, 0)
count_no_break = where(no_break, 1, 0)

# === CUMULATIVE TRACKING ===
cumulative_two_way = cumulative(agg=sum)(count_two_way)
cumulative_any = cumulative(agg=sum)(count_any)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 1: KEY METRICS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Breakout Statistics',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Breakout Days', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, 
                      info='Days with at least one breakout (up or down)'),
            ColumnSpec(title='Two-Way Breakout Days', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                      card_color=Color.Warning, info='Days with BOTH upside and downside breakouts'),
            ColumnSpec(title='Upside Only Days', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                      card_color=Color.Success, info='Days with only upside breakout'),
            ColumnSpec(title='Downside Only Days', card_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                      card_color=Color.Error, info='Days with only downside breakout')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Key Metrics'
)(count_any, count_two_way, count_upside_only, count_downside_only)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 2: BREAKOUT DISTRIBUTION
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    title='Breakout Pattern Distribution',
    category='2. Breakout Patterns',
    x_axis_label='Pattern Type',
    y_axis_label='Number of Days',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Upside Only', color=Color.Success),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Downside Only', color=Color.Error),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Two-Way Breakout', color=Color.Warning),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='No Breakout', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(count_upside_only, count_downside_only, count_two_way, count_no_break)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 3: OPENING RANGE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Opening Range Statistics',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg OR Width', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3,
                      info='Average opening range size (high-low) as % of open'),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max OR Width', card_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min OR Width', card_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Median OR Width', card_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Opening Range'
)(or_width_pct, or_width_pct, or_width_pct, or_width_pct)

histogram(
    title='Opening Range Size Distribution',
    category='3. Opening Range',
    bins=50,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='Opening Range Width (%)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2
)(or_width_pct)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 4: TIME SERIES
# =============================================================================

timeseries_lines(
    title='Cumulative Breakout Counts Over Time',
    category='4. Time Series',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Total Breakouts', color=Color.Primary, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Two-Way Breakouts', color=Color.Warning, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ])
)(cumulative_any, cumulative_two_way)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 5: DETAILED DATA
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Daily Breakout Details',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Width %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Up Breakout', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Down Breakout', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Two-Way', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat,
                      info='Both up and down breakouts on same day')
        ],
        include_timestamp=True
    ),
    category='5. Detailed Data'
)(or_high, or_low, or_width_pct, upside_break_day, downside_break_day, two_way_break)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS - CATEGORY 6: SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakout Statistics Summary',
        col_headers=['Count', 'Percentage'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Total Breakout Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Two-Way Breakout Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Upside Only Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Downside Only Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='No Breakout Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='6. Summary'
)(count_any, count_any, count_two_way, count_two_way, count_upside_only, count_upside_only, count_downside_only, count_downside_only, count_no_break, count_no_break)
